MOD = 998244353

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    N = int(data[0])
    M = int(data[1])
    L = int(data[2])
    R = int(data[3])
    
    temp = N * M
    base = R - L + 1
    exp = temp
    
    if temp % 2 == 1:
        res = pow(base, exp, MOD)
        print(res % MOD)
    else:
        res = pow(base, exp, MOD)
        if (R - L) % 2 == 0:
            res += 1
        inv2 = pow(2, MOD - 2, MOD)
        res = (res * inv2) % MOD
        print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
